prompt.project_info: A playful romantic studio fashion portrait with a giant teddy bear and red roses.
prompt.main_subject: An adult woman with fair skin and long auburn hair, calm neutral expression, wearing a pink satin mini dress with ribbon straps, a ruffled hem, and opaque lining. She holds a single red rose.
prompt.composition_elements: Eye-level medium portrait on a decorative bench. One hand rests near her collarbone and the other holds the rose. A large beige teddy bear sits closely behind her and a bouquet of red roses rests beside her; clean neutral studio background, no text or logos.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft even studio light creates gentle highlights on skin and satin. Romantic, intimate, slightly whimsical palette of pink, red, beige, and soft white.
prompt.technical_specs: High-resolution fashion photography, medium eye-level framing, sharp subject focus with minimal background distraction, natural satin folds and plush teddy texture.
